_doc: Triage knowledge for netmon reports. 'signatures': Suricata rule names judged benign in this house (substring match) with the reason. 'names': labels for IPs missing from the DHCP inventory. Edit as you learn; report.py shows tuned signatures as noise, not signal. 'dns_domains': registered domains cleared of DNS-tunnel suspicion (excluded from tunnel alarms). 'beacon_domains': registered domains whose periodic check-ins are expected (excluded from beacon alarms).

signatures.Session Traversal Utilities for NAT (STU: (why this is benign on your network)
signatures.GPL ICMP PING: (why this is benign on your network)
signatures.Github CDN for Release Assets: (why this is benign on your network)
signatures.External IP Lookup Domain: (why this is benign on your network)

_doc_signatures: Suricata alert names (substring match) you have judged harmless in your network, with the reason. They are shown as noise, not signal, in reports and the AI review. Only add a signature after you know exactly what generates it.
_doc_names: Labels for IP addresses that are not in your DHCP inventory (gateways, VIPs, appliances), so they show a name instead of a bare address.
_doc_dns_domains: Registered domains cleared of DNS-tunnelling suspicion (high-volume, high-entropy lookups that are legitimate, such as security products and reverse DNS). They are excluded from tunnel alarms.
_doc_beacon_domains: Registered domains whose regular check-ins are expected (NTP, Apple, cloud IoT vendors, DNS-over-HTTPS). They are excluded from beaconing / C2 alarms. Subdomains match.
